footnote_text: On July 9, 2026, Datasea Intelligent Technology Ltd. (the "Company") issued 150,000 restricted Class A ordinary shares of the Company, without par value, to the Reporting Person as additional quarterly compensation for his services with the Company, pursuant to an arrangement approved by the compensation committee of the Company's board of directors in December 2025 under the Company's 2018 Equity Incentive Plan, as amended. On the same date, the Company also issued 89,862 restricted Class A ordinary shares of the Company, without par value, to the Reporting Person as payment of accrued and unpaid salary for the period from January 2026 to June 2026, as approved by the Company's board of directors on June 30, 2026.
